answer: Canyon Timing Admission. Each identity must send its first N messages with inter-arrival gaps drawn from a wide distribution; agents whose traffic is too smooth or too bursty get quarantined to an island of low-priority queues. A violet flag marks identities whose gap variance falls outside the accepted band. An attacker must either spend real time spacing each sybil's traffic to mimic organic variance, or pay for many parallel machines idling between sends—costing hours of wall-clock delay per identity before it can act.
